drawings.description: sous les mots encerclés « Topos non cohérent », un croquis : deux ovales « $Z'$ » et « $Z''$ » qui se recouvrent, la région commune marquée « $I$ » ; au-dessus, entre les deux, « $W$ » ; au-dessous, un trait terminé par une pointe vers le bas.
drawings.kind: two overlapping ovals with a marked intersection
drawings.notes: Two ovals overlapping: Z' on the left, Z'' on the right (tilted, rising to the right), I in the common region. Above them, between the two, a W with a stroke running from it down into the common region; below, a short stroke leaving the common region to the lower left, with a small v-shaped arrow head under it. Partial: the wavy scribbles inside Z' (left of I) and inside Z'' (right of I, two of them) are not drawn: they may be small illegible labels or shading; the stroke from W is drawn as one curve where the page has two overlapping passes. The ringed words above (Topos non coherent, set in the transcription as the marginal note) are not drawn. The transcription's note does not mention the W. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
